title: Sprint Contract Entry
description: One line of specs/_epic/contracts.jsonl. Append-only log of per-sprint contracts negotiated between generator and evaluator. Lifecycle: agreed (after negotiation) -> completed (after evaluator QA passes) -> amended (rare, only when implementation reveals contract issue and evaluator approves the amendment). Each line is independent JSON.

contract_id.description: Contract identifier. Format: C-S{NN}-v{N} where S{NN} matches sprint id and v{N} is the negotiation revision (v1 first agreement, v2+ if amended). Same contract_id appears across phase transitions.

sprint.description: Sprint id this contract covers. Must match a sprint in spec.md sprint plan.

phase.description: Lifecycle state. agreed: negotiation done, generator may begin implementation. completed: evaluator QA passed all thresholds. amended: contract was revised mid-sprint (a new entry with same contract_id and incremented v in contract_id captures the amendment).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this entry was appended.

features_covered.description: F-ids from spec.md this sprint delivers. Required for phase=agreed.

done_looks_like.description: Human-readable bulleted statements of what 'done' means for this sprint, per Anthropic v2 negotiation. Required for phase=agreed. Each statement should be a behavioral outcome, not an implementation note. For module-touching sprints, generator ALSO includes one item per module touched using the canonical embedding shape from deep-module-handbook references/generator-slice.md §1.5 (carrying hides_decision, applicability, entry-point budget, Strategy seam, broad interface, bounded context, optional deletion-test pre-commitment). Free-text string format is deliberate (LLM-readable); the canonical embedding gives evaluator a deterministic per-module parse target.

verification_plan.description: Concrete, executable steps the evaluator runs to verify done_looks_like. Required for phase=agreed. Each step has a unique id (vp-NN) referenced by criterion_mapping.

^.+$.description: verification_plan step ids that contribute evidence for this criterion.

criterion_mapping.description: Maps each of the 4 evaluation criteria (from spec.md) to the verification_plan steps that exercise it. All 4 criteria from spec.md MUST appear as keys. Required for phase=agreed.

per_criterion.description: Optional per-criterion threshold overrides. Default is 'all required-pass' for hard criteria.

thresholds.description: Hard thresholds for sprint completion. Any threshold below pass = sprint FAIL = generator gets feedback. Required for phase=agreed.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to runtime evidence (Claude Code transcript slice) that backs this completion. Required for phase=completed.

amendment_reason.description: Why the contract was amended (e.g., 'spec referenced /api/v1 but planner intended /api/v2'). Required for phase=amended.

id.description: Step id, unique within this contract. Referenced by criterion_mapping.

kind.description: What kind of verification. playwright: end-to-end browser flow. api: HTTP request/response. test: unit/integration test runner. matrix: deterministic sensor (perf/race/locale/sca/secret/mutation). manual: human verification (rare, only for vision/aesthetic checks the evaluator can't automate).

steps.description: Ordered steps for kind=playwright|api|manual. Each step is a discrete action or assertion.

expected_outcome.description: Optional: explicit pass criterion. Default is 'all steps succeed' for playwright/api/manual; 'exit 0' for test; 'all checks pass' for matrix.
